🎥🩸: Simon Says (2026)

What begins as an exciting birthday bash quickly spirals into a gruesome fight for survival when a sinister stranger traps the guests inside a deadly game of “Simon Says.” Every order must be followed exactly, and the punishment for failure is swift, brutal, and permanent.

With escape seemingly impossible, alliances crumble as fear takes over and every new command forces impossible choices. The game’s twisted mastermind delights in manipulating the group, turning a simple childhood pastime into a relentless nightmare where no one is safe.

Filled with creative kills, razor-sharp suspense, and dark comedic moments, Simon Says delivers a fast-paced horror experience that proves the deadliest games are the ones everyone already knows.

Simon Says is out now on Tubi.
